entries.title: An older copy still running no longer stops the update
entries.body: When Firstmate 3000 or an earlier Infinitary is still running with no window, such as background work or one started from a terminal, Infinitary now asks it to save and stop, then brings your saved work over. If it does not stop, Infinitary asks before ending it.
entries.noPicture: The window shows its one new line only for the few seconds the older copy takes to stop, so a still picture shows little.
